SamarkandDesc: :Destroy falling meteorites to protect the blue dome of Samarkand.
SamarkandHelp: Press Spacebar to start the next stage.
SamarkandIntro:
The beautiful blue city of Samarkand.
Where the great astronomer Ulugh Beg mapped the stars...
Year 1420.
Stands the long-enduring Ulugh Beg Observatory and
the iconic blue mosaic dome of Samarkand.
However, a massive swarm of meteorites appears in the sky.
As these meteorites fall onto the ground or the observatory,
they shatter the blue ceramic bricks supporting the observatory one by one.
If all the bricks supporting the observatory are broken,
the glorious history and the legacy of astronomy will vanish without a trace.
Please protect Samarkand by intercepting the meteorites with your wisdom and typing speed!

[How to Play]
• White Meteors: Normal meteorite (100 pts).
• Yellow Meteors: Special items that help you (Shield, Freeze, Heal, etc.).
• Red Meteors: Fast-falling meteorites. Shatter 2 bricks on hit, award 200 pts.
• Golden Comets: Extremely fast. Award 500 pts and trigger Fever Mode! (0 damage on hit).

(Press ESC to skip)
SamarkandRulesObjDesc: Type the falling words before they hit the tower. Protect the blue dome of Samarkand!
SamarkandRulesMeteorDesc: Falls faster, shatters 2 bricks on hit. Awards 200 points.
SamarkandRulesShieldDesc: Creates a green energy dome that absorbs 1 collision damage.
SamarkandRulesFreezeDesc: Freezes all falling words on screen for 5 seconds.
SamarkandRulesSlowDesc: Slows down all falling words on screen for 8 seconds.
SamarkandRulesBombDesc: Explodes all active words on the screen. (50 points each)
SamarkandRulesHealDoubleDesc: Heal restores 1 broken brick. Double Score doubles gained points for 10 seconds.
SamarkandRulesCometDesc: Extremely fast golden comet. Typing awards 500 points and instantly triggers Fever Mode! Deals 0 damage on hit.
SamarkandRulesComboDesc:
• Type correctly without typos to build your combo.
• Every 5 combos increase the score multiplier by +0.25x (up to 2.5x).
• Reaching 15 combos triggers Fever Mode with shield activation.
• Making a typo or taking tower damage resets the combo to 0.

ApiGuideContent:
1. Click the link above to open Google AI Studio and sign in with Google.
2. Click the 'Get API key' button (top-left).
3. Click the 'Create API key' button.
4. Click 'Create API key in new project' to generate a key.
5. Copy the key (starts with AIzaSy...) and paste it in the box above.
